editorial_review.method: Read selections chronologically, evaluate current entries against strictly earlier selections and own-date cited headlines/card, and use family counts only as diagnostics. Proposed earlier-date replacement was drafted before later-date retail review. No future performance informed the replacements.

The final proposed lead is framed as expansion/discovery; broad technology comparisons do not assert Nebius contracts, capacity, revenue or measured retail participation.

manual_findings.proposal: Add own-date May19 Reuters n6624 directly connecting gold safe-haven demand to the downgrade.

limits: Source-index timestamps and headline metadata do not establish original article-body vintages.
Named historical episodes expressed only as generic behavioural mechanisms were not treated as evidence of episode-specific returns or chronology.
Attention from company coverage, price reaction, analyst opinion and products is kept distinct from a measured retail-platform sentiment reading.
This review does not accept final decisions, mutate specs or bind the final retail_quality.json receipt.
